Hi Emily / Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the concrete next steps so we can get a draft commercial in front of your procurement team:

- Primary deployment: Private VPC (customer-managed VPC peering) with keys in your KMS.
- Expected usage profile: mix of short chat-style requests + some long-context summarization; we discussed 100M+ tokens/month baseline with spikes.
- Required environments: production + staging + sandbox/dev (please confirm exact counts below).
- Security: SOC 2 + customer-managed logging + audit reports required.

Pricing items we need to confirm for a proposal:
1) Monthly token volume (range): helps us size committed tiers and unit economics. Example tiers we typically price against: 50M, 200M, 500M, 1B tokens/month.
2) Budget range: target monthly spend you have in mind (order of magnitude).
3) Environment count: number of isolated environments that need private deployment (prod/staging/others).
4) Support tier: standard vs premium/enterprise (SLA hours, on-call, monthly business review).

High-level licensing model options we discussed (so you have the terms in writing):
- Option A: Per-environment annual license + committed token tier (monthly drawdown). Overages billed at committed unit price.
- Option B: Platform subscription (license covers up to N environments) + usage-based token pricing on top.

Ballpark unit economics to use for internal alignment: when committing to a 6–12 month reserved token tier, teams we work with target ~ $500–1,200 per 1M tokens depending on model/quantization and support level. We'll refine against your exact mix.

Attached: Redwood_Private_Pricing_Workbook.xlsx — a short workbook with sample committed tier pricing, license line-item examples, and support tier descriptions.

Emily / Daniel — great, thanks for the details. Below are proposed commercial assumptions and next steps; we'll attach a one-pager for procurement shortly.

Proposed assumptions (for the 400M expected tier):
- Committed tokens: 400M tokens/month (12-month term).
- Unit price: $800 per 1M tokens (committed tier). That implies ~ $320k/month for tokens pre-license; we will refine with quantization/model discounts.
- License: Per-environment annual license of $25k/environment (prod/staging/sandbox = 3 envs => $75k/year). Alternatively, we can offer a platform subscription that covers up to 3 environments for $180k/year — I'll include both line items in the draft so procurement can choose.
- Support: Enterprise support (24/7 on-call, 2hr critical) — delta vs standard: +$15k/month. We'll show standard vs enterprise in the workbook.
- Overages: billed at 120% of committed unit price.

Why this is the proposed structure:
- The per-environment license ensures iso tenancy & support coverage for each environment.
- Committed token tiers allow us to offer the lower unit price; we can also model burst capacity.

Attached: updated Redwood_Private_Pricing_Workbook.xlsx (includes line-item costs and a tab showing $/1M sensitivity at 50M/200M/400M/750M tiers).
